summary:
Gold Fields disclosed in a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) that it confidentially submitted a non-binding, indicative, conditional proposal on 13 September 2026 to acquire 100% of Northern Star Resources via an Australian scheme of arrangement, later made public after Northern Star's ASX announcement responding to media speculation. Terms: 0.3125 Gold Fields shares plus A$7.25 cash per Northern Star share, implying A$27.00 per share as of 13 September 2026, with Northern Star holders owning roughly 33% of the combined group. The Northern Star board's 24 September 2026 letter said further engagement was not appropriate at this time; estimated synergies of US$4-5 billion were cited. Watch for a possible refreshed bid or hostile turn, Northern Star's defense posture, and scheme-timing and regulatory risk given the board's current refusal.
